<h2>Validate Trait Source Scale Rules</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Fails closed unless source-scale rules match the VegVault release,
source metadata, selectors, and expected record counts exactly.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_trait_source_scale_rules(
  data_trait_source_scale_rules,
  data_trait_records,
  path_vegvault,
  data_vegvault_release
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_source_scale_rules">data_trait_source_scale_rules</code></td>
<td>
<p>Rules loaded by [load_trait_source_scale_rules()]. A rule set with no
rows is valid.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records">data_trait_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>Untouched extracted trait records containing 'data_source_id'. Records
without a data source ('NA') match no rule.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_vegvault">path_vegvault</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar path to the VegVault SQLite database.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_vegvault_release">data_vegvault_release</code></td>
<td>
<p>A one-row data frame with the VegVault release record the pipeline
built from the same file (the 'config_vegvault_release' target), as
returned by [load_vegvault_database_version()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>[validate_vegvault_release()] first confirms that the file holds the
release in 'data_vegvault_release'. Every rule must then name that
release in 'vegvault_version'. The source descriptions are read from
the file with a read-only connection.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The validated source-scale rule tibble.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[load_trait_source_scale_rules()],
[apply_trait_source_scale_rules()], [validate_vegvault_release()]
</p>

</main>
